subject: Security intake: SOC 2 / GDPR / air-gapped deployment options
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@coralhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Singh <raj.singh@coralhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Initial security intake and questions (SOC 2, GDPR, air-gap)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking the time on the discovery call earlier. I wanted to capture a few follow-up items from our side and share CoralHealth's initial constraints so we can get a Vendor Security Questionnaire started. High-level asks: 

- Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 status (which Trust Services Criteria are covered, and date of most recent report)?
- We need to understand GDPR data flow and your approach to data residency for EU tenants.
- Do you support fully air-gapped / on-prem deployments for PHI (HIPAA)? If so, what is the usual delivery model and estimated timeline?
- Can you provide a simple deployment diagram showing network isolation options (VPC peering vs. private control plane vs. on-prem bundle)?

We're preparing our security committee packet and will kick off the vendor questionnaire once we have the SOC 2 pointer and a short architecture diagram. Attaching the vendor questionnaire template we prefer (initial fill).

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel; vendor security questionnaire template)

Appreciate any quick notes we can include in the packet. If it helps, happy to book a 30-minute follow-up with your security lead next week.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Director, IT Security
CoralHealth
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@coralhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Raj Singh <raj.singh@coralhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 17:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial security intake and questions (SOC 2, GDPR, air-gap)

Marta — thanks for the clear list and for the questionnaire. Past call was helpful; below is a short summary and immediate next steps so your security committee has something to work with while we prepare the docs you requested.

Quick answers / summary:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering Security and Availability. Last audit period ended 2026-11-30; report is available under NDA.
- GDPR / data residency: We support EU-region tenancy for hosted workloads. For Private/VPC and on-prem deployments, customer data remains in the customer-managed VPC or on-prem environment; control plane metadata can be optionally routed through a private control plane.
- Air-gapped / on-prem: We offer an on-prem deployment package for regulated workloads that can operate in an air-gapped network. Typical delivery involves an appliance bundle + orchestration scripts and a one-week on-site engagement for a first install. Timeline: 6-8 weeks from contract for a standard on-prem delivery (shorter with pre-approved architecture).
- Network isolation options: VPC peering (hosted with VPC peering and strict security groups), Private control plane with customer-managed peering, or fully on-prem air-gapped bundle. I'll attach a simple sketch for your committee.

Next steps / actions we can take this week:
1) Share SOC 2 cover letter and auditor contact under NDA — I will have Legal send the NDA and then the report link (target: Mon 22 Feb).
2) Fill initial tabs in your attached questionnaire (we'll return a completed XLS with answers flagged where we need follow-up).
3) Share a concise architecture sketch illustrating the three isolation modes (attachment).
4) Propose a 30-minute technical Q&A with our Solutions Architect (Karthik) next Tue/Wed.

Karthik — can you pick two slots Tue/Wed that work for a 30-min deep-dive on network controls, KMS/HSM integrations, and air-gap deployment mechanics?

Attachments: network_diagram_sketch.pdf (PDF; 1 page, conceptual)

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Raj Singh <raj.singh@coralhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@coralhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial security intake and questions (SOC 2, GDPR, air-gap)

Olga — thanks for the rapid reply and the sketch. A couple of clarifying items from our security committee after reviewing your notes: 

- For the SOC 2: can you confirm whether Encryption at Rest uses customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in the Private/VPC model, or if REDWOOD manages keys for hosted tenants? We need that explicitly noted in the questionnaire.
- For the air-gapped option: does the on-prem appliance collect any call-home telemetry? Our compliance requires zero outbound connections from the air-gapped environment unless through an approved transfer mechanism.
- Data retention and deletion: we need the standard retention period and the process to request complete dataset deletion for an EU tenant.

We can take the NDA now if that speeds the SOC 2 delivery. Also, please mark any questionnaire responses that are redlines we need Legal to review.

Thanks,
Raj
Head of Compliance, CoralHealth
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Raj Singh <raj.singh@coralhealth.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@coralhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial security intake and questions (SOC 2, GDPR, air-gap)

Raj / Marta — appreciate the checklist. Answers inline and concrete next steps below.

Inline answers:
- KMS/HSM: In the Private/VPC model customers can use customer-managed KMS keys (we integrate with cloud KMS and can support HSM-backed keys). For hosted tenants Redwood manages encryption keys by default; customer-managed keys are available for Dedicated and Private deployments. We'll note the distinction in the questionnaire.
- Air-gapped telemetry: The on-prem appliance has an optional telemetry collector used for support; it is disabled by default in air-gapped installs. Our standard air-gapped package ships with telemetry disabled and no call-home. Any outbound transfers for updates are handled through an explicit, tracked import process. We'll document that as a policy item.
- Data retention / deletion: Default retention for logs/metrics is 90 days; tenant data retention is configurable and we provide a documented deletion procedure (we'll attach the deletion runbook). For EU tenants data residency is respected in the Private deployment.

Immediate next steps we will take (deliverables and owners):
1) Legal: I will loop Legal to send an NDA today so we can share the SOC 2 report link (Owner: Marissa).
2) Security questionnaire: Karthik and I will populate the vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx and flag items for legal review. (Owner: Karthik / Olga)
3) Architecture artifacts: attaching network_diagram_sketch.pdf as a conceptual starting point; we will expand to a multi-page topology if you want specific CIDR and peering details.
4) Technical Q&A: Proposed slots 
   - Tue 23 Feb 09:00-09:30 CET (Karthik)
   - Wed 24 Feb 15:00-15:30 CET (Karthik)
Please pick one and we'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire_v1_filled_initial.xlsx (Excel; partial answers + flags), network_diagram_sketch.pdf, deletion_runbook_excerpt.txt (TXT; 3 paragraphs)

If it's helpful, I'll also share a short note on our certification roadmap (planned ISO 27001 assessment in Q3 2027) so your committee has visibility.

Olga
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
